Overdue notices now say how many days late the item is. The body reads, for example, `... was due back on 2026-11-21. It is 5 days late. Please return it to any branch.` An item one day late reads "It is 1 day late." All 60 tests pass.

- **`lib/notices/templates.js`:** the `overdue` template gains the sentence `It is {lateBy} late.`
- **`lib/notices/digest.js`:** `overdueNotices` works out the days late with `daysBetween(loan.dueOn, today)`. It passes that to the template as `lateBy`, with "day" or "days" as appropriate. `dueSoonNotices` is unchanged.
- **`test/notices.test.js`:** a new test checks both the "5 days" and "1 day" wording.
